title: Asset Manifest
description: Inventory of generated/sourced assets produced by the Asset Generator.

path.description: Relative path within the pipeline project directory

generation_summary.description: Brief summary of how the asset was generated or sourced

original_url.description: Source URL if downloaded from a stock service

voice_performance.description: Applied voice-performance contract for narration assets.

kind.description: Media class as the acquiring tool reported it, kept alongside `type` because `type` also carries editorial role (narration, music, and sfx are all audio). The persian-footage pipeline gates on this: an asset with kind 'image' is rejected outright.

beat_id.description: Beat this asset fills, for beat-structured pipelines. Distinct from scene_id, which groups beats.

public_path.description: Optional path relative to remotion-composer/public/, for pipelines that pre-stage their media. persian-footage does not: persian_compose copies each shot's source into public/persian/<run-id>/ at render time and deletes it afterwards, so it reads `path` and never this field. Recording it is harmless; relying on it is not.

source_in_seconds.description: In-point inside the source clip. Stock footage frequently opens on a fade or the wrong framing, so 0 is a default rather than a decision.

attribution.description: Human-readable credit line. Both Pexels and Pixabay require it, and persian_compose refuses to render a shot without one.

shows_subject.description: Whether the video's declared visual subject is legible in this clip — not a blurred shape in the background. persian-footage holds an anchor quota against this field (first beat, last beat, and at least 40% of footage beats), which is what stops a video about coffee from becoming a video about a medical check-up one defensible query at a time.

selection_reason.description: One line naming what is IN FRAME, in the project's language. 'best match' is not a reason: a manifest recording twelve chosen clips and nothing about what any showed makes 'waist measurement' and 'coffee cup' look identical at the checkpoint.

format.description: Frame orientation this manifest was acquired for, carried from the brief so the edit stage cannot silently mix orientations.

word_timings.description: Word-level narration timings from transcription, as the transcriber emitted them (snake_case). persian-footage turns these into a sidecar .srt; nothing on screen is locked to a word, so sub-tenth-second drift is cosmetic. Distinct from edit_decisions.persian.audio.wordTimings (camelCase), which is the same word list restated at the compose boundary where persian_compose reads it — the manifest records what transcription produced, the edit decisions carry what compose consumes.

music.description: Acquired music bed, when one exists. Absent is legitimate: no music provider is guaranteed to be configured. Same record shape as edit_decisions.persian.musicTrack (lib.persian_music.MusicTrack / build_music_track) — the shape the music gate requires — so a bed the manifest records is a bed compose can stage and audit without restating.

path.description: Real location on disk; the field persian_compose reads and stages.

source.description: Tool the file came from: pixabay_music, freesound_music, or user-provided.

license.description: The licence record, so the claim is checkable by a human rather than trusted from a string.

name.description: The licence name as published at the source, verbatim (e.g. Pixabay Content License).

url.description: The licence page the claim was read from.

downloadedAt.description: ISO date the file was downloaded; licences change.

attribution.description: Attribution line, where the licence or the source asks for one.

contentIdRisk.description: The honest Content-ID judgement, with its reason, so a later reader can disagree with evidence.

level.description: low must cite a recognised licence; high is refused; unknown passes only with a recorded acknowledgement.

musicTrack.description: Alias for the same music record under the name the edit stage and the asset-director use (edit_decisions.persian.musicTrack). Accepted here so a manifest written in the edit stage's vocabulary validates; must not appear alongside `music` describing a different file.
